+from __future__ import annotations

+PAPER_LEFT_Y = 0.1136

+
+def move_xyz(xyz, speed=0.045, settle=0.2, orientation=DOWN):
+    """Move tip to xyz, using <= speed/20 metres per target row."""
+    p = now_pose()
+    dest = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), np.asarray(orientation, dtype=float)]
+    distance = np.linalg.norm(dest[:3] - p[:3])
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(distance / (speed / 20.0))))
+    rows = np.linspace(p, dest, n + 1)[1:]
+    res = R.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=0.05, video="none")
+    if settle > 0:
+        hold = np.repeat(dest[None, :], max(1, int(round(settle * 20))), axis=0)
+        res = R.submit("ee_pose", hold, dt=0.05, video="none")
+    return res

+def paper_xy(uv):
+    """Target raster center -> world x,y; orientation per target_image."""
+    u, v = uv
+    X, Y = (u + .5) * MM_PX, (v + .5) * MM_PX
